faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 2 bedroom condos sell for in Surrey?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in Surrey, 406 sold over the past year at a median of $508,500, with the middle half between $465,000 and $549,975.

faq.q: How fast do 2 bedroom condos sell in Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 29 days, and homes sold for 97.0% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in Surrey do most 2 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Whalley, with 231 of the 406 sales at a median of $510,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Surrey have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Sommerset (5 sales, median $520,000); Pura (5 sales, median $555,000); The Highlands (5 sales, median $484,000); Cartier Place (4 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in Surrey was $461 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in Surrey compare
A 2 bedroom condo in Surrey sold for $133,550 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($508,500 against $374,950, 340 sales). The strata fee was $461 a month against $343.
A 2 bedroom condo in Surrey sold for $71,000 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($508,500 against $579,500, 38 sales). The strata fee was $461 a month against $503.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, Surrey has the 7th highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
